title: XGBoost-selected variables build a 3-year diabetes risk model in Chinese adults
summary: In 15,928 Chinese adults, XGBoost selected 10 of 15 candidate variables and a stepwise model with nomogram reached AUC 0.933 (training) and 0.910 (validation); AUC in an external cohort of 11,113 Japanese participants was 0.830. Fasting plasma glucose, BMI and age were the top predictors. The cohort is observational, and the final model is a stepwise regression on the ML-selected variables.
ai_technology: XGBoost variable selection followed by a stepwise logistic model and nomogram
organization: Shenzhen University; Shenzhen University Health Science Center; Shenzhen Second People's Hospital

evidence.tested: Internal validation and external validation in 11,113 Japanese participants.
evidence.unknown: Performance was lower in the external cohort; clinical benefit is not tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selected the most important predictors for the final risk model.
